summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The State Street SPDR MSCI World StrategicFactors ETF (QWLD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI World Factor Mix A-Series index. The fund tracks an index of developed-market securities that consists of 3 subindexes based on value, minimum volatility and quality. QWLD was launched on Jun 4, 2014 and is issued by State Street.

holdings.infoBox: QWLD is an equity ETF with a total of 1240 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 3.12%, Apple at 2.55%, NVIDIA at 2.50%, Meta Platforms at 2.28%, and Alphabet at 2.04%.
